title: Time-Varying Heterogeneous Treatment Effects in Event Studies
text: Time-varying heterogeneous treatment effects event studies, following Botosaru & Liu (2025, 2026).

title: Time-Varying Heterogeneous Treatment Effects in Event Studies
text: Standard event-study regressions (TWFE event-time dummies) implicitly assume unit time fixed effects absorb serial correlation residual. outcomes genuinely persistent — earnings, employment, consumption, anything habit adjustment costs — event-time dummies pick persistence top causal effect, producing spurious pre-trends biased post-treatment estimates. tvhte implements Botosaru & Liu’s two-step semiparametric estimator: Marginal-likelihood QMLE common parameters (ρ_Y, ρ_δ, σ_U, σ_ε) latent prior, integrating unit-level random coefficients (α_i, δ_{i0}) Gaussian working assumption. Consistent misspecification prior. Tweedie / Gaussian-conjugate empirical Bayes posterior means unit-specific treatment trajectories {δ_{,j}}, achieving asymptotic ratio optimality. dimensionality reduction comes imposing AR(1) event-time effects, δ_{ij} = ρ_δ δ_{,j-1} + ε_{ij}, δ_{i0} free.

title: Time-Varying Heterogeneous Treatment Effects in Event Studies
text: Phase 1 (linear-Gaussian, common adoption timing, covariates). Forthcoming: Phase 2: strictly exogenous covariates X_{}'β. Phase 3: staggered adoption cohort-specific conditioning. Phase 4: full MC validation suite. Phase 5: feedback / endogenous covariate adjustment (Botosaru-Liu 2026). Phase 6: Great Recession county-unemployment replication vignette.

title: Simulate from the Botosaru-Liu (2025) TV-HTE model — simulate_tvhte
text: Draws dataset N units observed times 0, 1, ..., T according $$Y_{} = \rho_Y Y_{,t-1} + \alpha_i + \sum_{j} D_{}^j \delta_{ij} + U_{}$$ $$\delta_{ij} = \rho_\delta \delta_{,j-1} + \varepsilon_{ij}, \quad j \geq 1$$ (alpha_i, delta_{i0}) jointly Gaussian.

title: Two-step TV-HTE estimator (Botosaru and Liu 2025) — tvhte
text: Fits linear-Gaussian dynamic-panel model correlated random coefficients $$Y_{} = \rho_Y Y_{,t-1} + \alpha_i + \sum_j D_{}^j \delta_{ij} + U_{}$$ $$\delta_{ij} = \rho_\delta \delta_{,j-1} + \varepsilon_{ij},\; j \geq 1$$ common treatment timing. latent lambda_i = (alpha_i, delta_{i0}) integrated Gaussian working assumption; step 1 estimate common parameters (lambda-prior parameters) QMLE resulting marginal multivariate-normal log-likelihood; step 2 form closed-form Gaussian posterior mean (alpha_i, delta_{i0}) unit. Botosaru-Liu (2025) paper shows QMLE remains consistent misspecification Gaussian working assumption lambda.
